claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing renewable-generation business, legal vehicle, and Nasdaq "TERP" listing continued intact (T4 stays), but the operational support processes (top management, O&M, asset management) that were formerly provided by SunEdison under a management services/O&M arrangement were severed and re-provided by Brookfield affiliates under a new master services agreement — a documented product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing where the delivering processes were swapped rather than moving intact with the product. gap_56=1: T5 processes were re-engineered/swapped to a new provider while the people running them changed — SunEdison-employed CEO/COO/CAO were replaced by Brookfield-arranged personnel (CEO, CFO, general counsel), so process transfer occurred without the same organization/people carrying it. gap_mitigated=yes: the shared substrate was contractually absorbed at closing via the new master services agreement (Sponsorship Agreements), the $500M sponsor line agreement, and the pipeline right of first offer, which allocate the management/operating support going forward.

grok.rationale: The structural summary states that at closing the customer-facing renewable-energy-generation business continued intact with the surviving public company and Nasdaq listing, so T4 and its operating processes remained together inside the same vehicle (gap_45=0). Concurrently the deal installed Sponsorship Agreements under which Brookfield affiliates supply the CEO, CFO, GC and related services at closing, aligning the re-sourced top-management layer with the continuing operations rather than leaving processes without an organization (gap_56=0).

openai.rationale: The structural summary states that the customer-facing renewable-energy-generation business continued intact, while operating support shifted from SunEdison arrangements to Brookfield affiliates under a new master services agreement; therefore, no product-versus-process mismatch is documented at closing (SEC accession 0001567619-17-001844, Form DEFM14A). The new agreement required Brookfield affiliates to arrange qualified personnel, including a full-time CEO, CFO, and general counsel dedicated primarily to the Company, aligning the restructured support processes with the organization responsible for running them; therefore, no process-versus-organization gap is documented (SEC accession 0001567619-17-001844, Form DEFM14A).
